name: Huella de Cuantización
description: Analiza JPEG tabla de cuantización fingerprints. Camera images show characteristic quantization patrones while AI images lack standard compression signatures.
mechanism: Analiza pixel value histogramas for periodic patrones caused by JPEG quantization. Camera images show comb-like patrones.
parameters: Periods: 2-8, Metrics: comb ratio, periodic score
useCase: Identifying compresión JPEG signatures from camera pipelines

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Farid, H. (2009). Exposing Digital Forgeries from JPEG Ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Lukáš, J. et al. (2006). Detecting Digital Image Forgeries Using Sensor Pattern Noise. SPIE.

strengths:
• Directly analiza compresión JPEG history
• Can identify specific compression software
• Reveals double compression and editing traces
• Standard tabla de cuantizacións are well-documented
• Very fast análisis of DCT coeficientes
limitations:
• Only applicable to JPEG format
• Custom tabla de cuantizacións complicate análisis
• Quality factor estimation has inherent uncertainty
• Non-JPEG AI images bypass this análisis
• Re-encoding masks original quantization
